info.name: ShopEase Product Catalog Service
info.description: Run top to bottom (Collection Runner). Set the collection variable jwt_secret to JWT_SECRET_KEY from .env. Tokens are generated automatically in the collection pre-request script. Each run uses its own run_id so it can be repeated on the same database.

exec: // Tokens are signed here with the shared JWT secret, exactly like the Authentication Service signs them (HS256: sub, role, iat, exp).
if (!secret) { throw new Error("Set the variable jwt_secret to JWT_SECRET_KEY from .env"); }
return head + "." + body + "." + b64u(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(head + "." + body, secret));
pm.collectionVariables.set("admin_token", sign({ sub: "1", role: "admin", iat: now, exp: now + 1800 }));
pm.collectionVariables.set("customer_token", sign({ sub: "2", role: "customer", iat: now, exp: now + 1800 }));
pm.collectionVariables.set("expired_token", sign({ sub: "1", role: "admin", iat: now - 7200, exp: now - 3600 }));
pm.test("Message: Not authenticated: Bearer token is missing", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Not authenticated: Bearer token is missing"); });
pm.test("Message: Token has expired", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Token has expired"); });

item.name: 04 Customer calls an admin API (create category)

exec: pm.test("Message: Administrator access is required for this operation", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Administrator access is required for this operation"); });
pm.test("Contains the new category", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(c => c.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("cat1"))); });

pm.test("Fields and computed values", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.stock_quantity).to.eql(50); pm.expect(j.final_price).to.eql("18000.00"); pm.expect(j.in_stock).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Message: Category with id 999999 does not exist", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Category with id 999999 does not exist"); });

body.raw:
{
  "category_id": {{cat1}},
  "name": "Smart Phone X",
  "description": "6.5 inch display",
  "sku": "PM-{{run_id}}-X",
  "price": "-5",
  "discount_price": null,
  "stock_quantity": 50,
  "image_url": "https://example.com/phone.png",
  "brand": "Acme",
  "is_active": true
}

exec: pm.test("Only active products, includes ours", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.every(p => p.is_active)).to.eql(true); pm.expect(j.items.map(p => p.id)).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("pid"))); });

pm.test("Updated, stock untouched", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql("Smart Phone X Pro"); pm.expect(j.final_price).to.eql("22000.00"); pm.expect(j.stock_quantity).to.eql(50); });

body.raw:
{
  "category_id": {{cat1}},
  "name": "Smart Phone X Pro",
  "description": "6.5 inch display",
  "sku": "PM-{{run_id}}-A",
  "price": "25000.00",
  "discount_price": "22000.00",
  "image_url": "https://example.com/phone.png",
  "brand": "Acme",
  "is_active": true
}

exec: pm.test("Only brand changed", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.brand).to.eql("Acme Plus"); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql("Smart Phone X Pro"); });

item.name: 19 Customer calls an admin API (create product)

exec: pm.test("Only the cable", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.items[0].sku).to.eql("PM-" + pm.collectionVariables.get("run_id") + "-B"); });
pm.test("Page data", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.page_size).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("Descending", function () { const p = pm.response.json().items.map(x => Number(x.final_price)); pm.expect(p).to.eql([...p].sort((a, b) => b - a)); pm.expect(p.length).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("50 to 75", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.previous_stock).to.eql(50); pm.expect(j.updated_stock).to.eql(75); pm.expect(j.transaction_type).to.eql("IN"); });
pm.test("75 to 55", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.previous_stock).to.eql(75); pm.expect(j.updated_stock).to.eql(55); pm.expect(j.transaction_type).to.eql("OUT"); });
pm.test("Message: Insufficient stock: 55 available, 56 requested", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Insufficient stock: 55 available, 56 requested"); });

item.name: 32 Verify stock was not changed by the failed requests

exec: pm.test("Three rows, newest first, continuous chain", function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.total).to.eql(3); pm.expect(j.items.map(i => i.transaction_type)).to.eql(["OUT","IN","IN"]); pm.expect(j.items[0].updated_stock).to.eql(55); pm.expect(j.items[0].previous_stock).to.eql(j.items[1].updated_stock); });

pm.test("Contains the cable (stock 3), not the phone", function () { const ids = pm.response.json().items.map(i => i.product_id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("pid2"))); pm.expect(ids).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("pid"))); });

38 Customer cannot see the inactive product

exec: pm.test("Message: Product deleted successfully", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Product deleted successfully"); });
pm.test("Message: Category deleted successfully", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Category deleted successfully"); });
